aos_model_eval_issuer_private.certificat.body:
BEGIN
      IF (TG_OP='INSERT' AND (NEW.epoch<>1 OR NEW.active_hash IS NULL
          OR NEW.active_hash<>NEW.certificate_hash))
        OR (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (
          (NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.certificate_hash)
            IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.org_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.certificate_hash)
          OR NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch+1 OR OLD.active_hash IS NULL OR NEW.active_hash IS NOT NULL))
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MODEL_CERTIFICATE_EPOCH_TRANSITION' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
      NEW.updated_at:=clock_timestamp(); RETURN NEW;
      END

aos_model_eval_issuer_private.derive_cer.body:
DECLARE c record; j jsonb; BEGIN
        SELECT h.root_hash INTO c FROM aos_model_eval_issuer_private.issuer_epoch h
          JOIN aos_model_eval_issuer_private.executor_certificate x ON
          (h.org_id,h.project_id,h.issuer_id,h.key_id)=(x.org_id,x.project_id,x.issuer_id,x.key_id)
          WHERE x.org_id=NEW.org_id AND x.project_id=NEW.project_id
            AND x.content_hash=NEW.certificate_hash FOR SHARE OF h;
        IF NOT FOUND OR c.root_hash IS NULL THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'MODEL_IDENTITY_ROOT_INACTIVE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
        SELECT x.*,h.active_hash INTO c FROM aos_model_eval_issuer_private.executor_certificate x
          JOIN aos_model_eval_issuer_private.certificate_epoch h ON
          (h.org_id,h.project_id,h.certificate_hash)=(x.org_id,x.project_id,x.content_hash)
          WHERE x.org_id=NEW.org_id AND x.project_id=NEW.project_id
            AND x.content_hash=NEW.certificate_hash FOR SHARE OF h;
        IF NOT FOUND OR c.active_hash IS NULL THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'MODEL_IDENTITY_CERTIFICATE_INACTIVE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
        j:=convert_from(c.body,'UTF8')::jsonb;
        IF j->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aos.model-eval-signed-certificate-envelope/v1'
          OR j#>>'{certificate,tenant,orgId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.org_id
          OR j#>>'{certificate,tenant,projectId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.project_id
          OR j#>>'{certificate,executionId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.execution_id
          OR j#>>'{certificate,caseId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.case_id
          OR j#>>'{certificate,purpose}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.purpose
          OR j#>>'{certificate,issuerId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.issuer_id
          OR j#>>'{certificate,issuerKeyId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.key_id
          OR j#>>'{certificate,leg,identityKeyHash}' IS DISTINCT FROM
             encode(sha256(decode(j#>>'{certificate,publicKeyBase64}','base64')),'hex')
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MODEL_IDENTITY_CERTIFICATE_BINDING' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
        NEW.identity_id:=j#>>'{certificate,leg,identityId}';
        NEW.purpose:=c.purpose;NEW.key_hash:=j#>>'{certificate,leg,identityKeyHash}';
        INSERT INTO aos_model_eval_issuer_private.identity_epoch(org_id,project_id,identity_id,purpose,key_hash,epoch,version,active)
          VALUES(NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.identity_id,NEW.purpose,NEW.key_hash,1,1,true)
          ON CONFLICT(org_id,project_id,identity_id) DO UPDATE SET version=identity_epoch.version+1
          WHERE identity_epoch.active AND identity_epoch.purpose=EXCLUDED.purpose
            AND identity_epoch.key_hash=EXCLUDED.key_hash;
        IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MODEL_IDENTITY_BOUND_OR_REVOKED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END

aos_model_eval_issuer_private.derive_sha.body:
DECLARE c record; j jsonb; m jsonb; leg jsonb; BEGIN
            SELECT h.root_hash INTO c FROM aos_model_eval_issuer_private.issuer_epoch h JOIN aos_model_eval_issuer_private.executor_certificate x
                ON (h.org_id,h.project_id,h.issuer_id,h.key_id)=(x.org_id,x.project_id,x.issuer_id,x.key_id)
                WHERE x.org_id=NEW.org_id AND x.project_id=NEW.project_id AND x.content_hash=NEW.certificate_hash FOR SHARE OF h;
            IF NOT FOUND OR c.root_hash IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SHARED_PARENT_ROOT_INACTIVE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
            SELECT x.*,h.active_hash,p.body AS manifest_body,p.content_hash AS manifest_hash INTO c
                FROM aos_model_eval_issuer_private.executor_certificate x JOIN aos_model_eval_issuer_private.certificate_epoch h
                ON (h.org_id,h.project_id,h.certificate_hash)=(x.org_id,x.project_id,x.content_hash)
                JOIN aos_model_eval_execution_private.manifest p ON (p.org_id,p.project_id,p.execution_id)=(x.org_id,x.project_id,x.execution_id)
                WHERE x.org_id=NEW.org_id AND x.project_id=NEW.project_id AND x.content_hash=NEW.certificate_hash FOR SHARE OF h;
            IF NOT FOUND OR c.active_hash IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SHARED_PARENT_CERTIFICATE_INACTIVE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
            j:=convert_from(c.body,'UTF8')::jsonb;m:=convert_from(c.manifest_body,'UTF8')::jsonb;
            SELECT v->c.purpose INTO leg FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'cases') v WHERE v->>'caseId'=c.case_id;
            IF j->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aos.model-eval-shared-parent-signed-certificate-envelope/v3'
                OR j#>>'{certificate,schemaVersion}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aos.model-eval-shared-parent-certificate-signing-input/v3'
                OR m->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aos.model-eval-target-judge-shared-risk-manifest/v3'
                OR m->>'executionId' IS DISTINCT FROM c.execution_id
                OR m#>>'{tenant,orgId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.org_id
                OR m#>>'{tenant,projectId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.project_id
                OR c.attempt<>1 OR leg IS NULL OR j#>'{certificate,leg}' IS DISTINCT FROM leg
                OR j#>>'{certificate,manifestHash}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.manifest_hash
                OR j#>>'{certificate,requestHash}' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN c.purpose='target' THEN m#>>'{judgeRequest,targetApplication,requestHash}' ELSE m->>'judgeRequestHash' END)
                OR j#>'{certificate,candidateRef}' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN c.purpose='target' THEN m#>'{judgeRequest,targetApplication,request,targetRef}' ELSE m#>'{judgeRequest,judgeGovernanceApplication,request,targetRef}' END)
                OR j#>>'{certificate,tenant,orgId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.org_id
                OR j#>>'{certificate,tenant,projectId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.project_id
                OR j#>>'{certificate,executionId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.execution_id
                OR j#>>'{certificate,caseId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.case_id
                OR j#>>'{certificate,purpose}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.purpose
                OR j#>>'{certificate,issuerId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.issuer_id
                OR j#>>'{certificate,issuerKeyId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.key_id
                OR octet_length(decode(j#>>'{certificate,publicKeyBase64}','base64')) IS DISTINCT FROM 32
                OR leg->>'identityKeyHash' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(decode(j#>>'{certificate,publicKeyBase64}','base64')),'hex')
            THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SHARED_PARENT_CERTIFICATE_BINDING' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
            NEW.identity_id:=leg->>'identityId';NEW.purpose:=c.purpose;NEW.key_hash:=leg->>'identityKeyHash';
            NEW.description_hash:=j#>>'{certificate,descriptionHash}';NEW.original_risk_hash:=j#>>'{certificate,originalRiskHash}';
            NEW.caller_xid:=j#>>'{certificate,callerXid}';NEW.caller_pid:=(j#>>'{certificate,callerPid}')::integer;
            INSERT INTO aos_model_eval_issuer_private.identity_epoch(org_id,project_id,identity_id,purpose,key_hash,epoch,version,active)
                VALUES(NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.identity_id,NEW.purpose,NEW.key_hash,1,1,true)
                ON CONFLICT(org_id,project_id,identity_id) DO UPDATE SET version=identity_epoch.version+1
                WHERE identity_epoch.active AND identity_epoch.purpose=EXCLUDED.purpose AND identity_epoch.key_hash=EXCLUDED.key_hash;
            IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SHARED_PARENT_IDENTITY_BOUND_OR_REVOKED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
            RETURN NEW; END

aos_model_eval_issuer_private.identity_e.body:
BEGIN
        IF pg_trigger_depth()<2 OR
          (TG_OP='INSERT' AND (NEW.epoch<>1 OR NEW.version<>1 OR NOT NEW.active)) OR
          (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (
            (NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.identity_id,NEW.purpose,NEW.key_hash)
              IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.org_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.identity_id,OLD.purpose,OLD.key_hash)
            OR NOT OLD.active OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1
            OR (NEW.active AND NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch)
            OR (NOT NEW.active AND NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch+1)))
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MODEL_IDENTITY_EPOCH_TRANSITION' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
        NEW.updated_at:=clock_timestamp();RETURN NEW;
      END

aos_model_eval_issuer_private.issuer_epo.body:
BEGIN
      IF (TG_OP='INSERT' AND (NEW.epoch<>1 OR NEW.root_hash IS NULL))
        OR (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (
          (NEW.org_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.issuer_id,NEW.key_id)
            IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.org_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.issuer_id,OLD.key_id)
          OR NEW.epoch<>OLD.epoch+1 OR OLD.root_hash IS NULL OR NEW.root_hash IS NOT NULL))
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MODEL_ISSUER_EPOCH_TRANSITION' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
      NEW.updated_at:=clock_timestamp(); RETURN NEW;
      END
